snippet.title: Scourge of Scavengers - Demo 2 Update
snippet.description:
Fly High!

Hello friends! It's me, fanimator! And this - is a trailer upon the arrival of the second demo of my super cool indie RPG - Scourge of Scavengers! It's been around two months, and I've cooked a LOT!
As always, you can download by following links on
Gamejolt (the cooler)
https://gamejolt.com/games/crowsarecool/880940
and Itch.io (the uncooler)
https://fanimatorofficial.itch.io/crowsarecool
Thank you everyone for giving honest opinions about it! After all, it's my first serious indie. I'm looking forward to continue the work and give you more cool interactions with cool characters!
